source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 22 (PDF 88-100), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 22 (Hydroxy Compounds) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are hydroxy compounds? How do alcohols and phenols differ in where the -OH group is attached?
(Hydroxy compounds kya hain? Alcohols aur phenols mein -OH group ke judne ki jagah ka kya farq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydroxy compounds woh organic compounds hain jin mein kam az kam aik hydroxyl (-OH) group ho. Alcohols mein -OH aliphatic carbon par aur phenols mein aryl (aromatic ring) carbon par juda hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Alcohols and phenols are hydroxy organic compounds with at least one hydroxyl group attached to an aliphatic or an aryl carbon, respectively.

blocks.prompt:
2 Why were phenol solutions first used in surgery, and why was their use later given up?
(Phenol solutions surgery mein pehle kyun istemal hue aur baad mein kyun chhod diye gaye?)
blocks.explanation: Pasteur ne bacteria ka wujood dikhaya to 1867 se surgical auzaar aur zakhm phenol solution se saaf hone lage; is ki taaqatwar antiseptic (jaraseem-kush) khaasiyat se mareezon ke bachne ke imkanaat barh gaye. Magar phenol sehatmand tissues ko jalata hai, is liye mutabadil dhoonde gaye.

book_ref.quote: After Louis Pasteur's research revealed the existence of bacteria, scientists started cleaning surgical instruments and wounds with phenol solutions in 1867.

blocks.prompt:
3 Give one use each of ethanol and phenol mentioned in the chapter.
(Chapter mein di gayi ethanol aur phenol ka aik aik istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethanol: bio-based maaddon se bana kar biofuel (petrol ka mutabadil) ke taur par. Phenol: disinfectants (jaraseem-kush) jaise soaps aur hospital ke disinfectant liquids mein.

book_ref.quote: Phenol is an ingredient in disinfectants, such as soaps, hospitals disinfectant liquids, etc.

blocks.prompt:
4 What is the functional group and general formula of alcohols? Name the first two members of monohydric alcohols.
(Alcohols ka functional group aur general formula kya hai? Monohydric alcohols ke pehle do members ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Functional group hydroxyl (-OH) hai aur general formula ROH, jahan R alkyl group hai. Pehle do members methanol CH₃OH aur ethanol CH₃CH₂OH hain.

book_ref.quote: Hydroxyl group (-OH) is the functional group of all alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
5 Why is C₆H₅OH not classed as an alcohol even though it contains an -OH group?
(C₆H₅OH mein -OH group hone ke bawajood isay alcohol kyun nahi kehte?)
blocks.explanation: C₆H₅OH mein -OH aromatic ring ke carbon (aryl carbon) se juda hai; aisa compound phenol hai. Alcohol mein -OH alkyl (aliphatic) carbon par hota hai, yani ROH mein R alkyl hai.

book_ref.quote: When the -OH group is bonded to an aryl (aromatic ring) carbon the compound is a phenol, not an alcohol

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between monohydric and polyhydric alcohols with one example of each.
(Monohydric aur polyhydric alcohols mein farq likhein, har aik ki aik misaal ke saath.)
blocks.explanation: In mein -OH groups ki tadaad ka farq hai:

book_ref.quote: Depending on the number of hydroxyl groups attached, alcohols can be classified into monohydric and polyhydric alcohols.

rows: Aik se ziyada -OH groups hote hain

blocks.prompt:
7 Give the IUPAC names of glycol and glycerol and state how many -OH groups each has.
(Glycol aur glycerol ke IUPAC naam likhein aur batayein har aik mein kitne -OH groups hain.)
blocks.explanation: Glycol 1,2-ethanediol hai (do -OH groups). Glycerol 1,2,3-propanetriol hai (teen -OH groups). Dono polyhydric alcohols hain.

book_ref.quote: they are 1,2-ethanediol and 1,2,3-propanetriol

blocks.prompt:
8 On what basis are alcohols classed as primary, secondary and tertiary? Give the general formula of each.
(Alcohols ko primary, secondary aur tertiary kis buniyaad par kaha jata hai? Har aik ka general formula likhein.)
blocks.explanation: -OH wale carbon se seedhe jude carbon atoms ki tadaad par: aik carbon se primary (1°) alcohol R₁CH₂OH; do se secondary (2°) R₂CHOH; teen se tertiary (3°) R₃COH.

book_ref.quote: Depending on the number of carbon atoms which are directly attached to the carbon that is bonded with the -OH group

blocks.prompt:
9 Classify propan-1-ol, propan-2-ol and 2-methylpropan-2-ol as primary, secondary or tertiary.
(Propan-1-ol, propan-2-ol aur 2-methylpropan-2-ol ko primary, secondary ya tertiary mein baantein.)
blocks.explanation: Propan-1-ol CH₃CH₂CH₂OH: primary (-OH wale carbon se aik carbon juda). Propan-2-ol CH₃CH(OH)CH₃: secondary (do carbons). 2-methylpropan-2-ol (CH₃)₃COH: tertiary (teen carbons).

book_ref.quote: A tertiary (3°) alcohol is one in which the OH group is attached a tertiary carbon atom.

blocks.prompt:
10 What is meant by saying that alcohols have a low degree of dissociation? Write the equilibrium.
(Alcohols ki dissociation ka darja kam hai, is ka kya matlab hai? Equilibrium likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Paani mein alcohol molecules bohat thode ions mein toot-te hain: ROH(aq) ⇌ RO⁻(aq) + H⁺(aq). Equilibrium left par hai, yani ROH molecules RO⁻ aur H⁺ ions se bohat ziyada hain.

book_ref.quote: This means that when dissolved in water, alcohol molecules do not dissociate (split up) to a great extent.

blocks.prompt:
11 Show from [H⁺(aq)] that alcohols are weaker acids than water.
([H⁺(aq)] se dikhayein ke alcohols paani se kamzor acids hain.)
blocks.explanation: ROH ⇌ RO⁻ + H⁺ aur H₂O ⇌ OH⁻ + H⁺ dono left par hain, magar paani ziyada H⁺ deta hai. Alcohols ka [H⁺(aq)] paani se kam hai, is liye woh paani se kamzor acids hain.

book_ref.quote: As alcohols have a lower [H⁺(aq)] in solution compared to water, alcohols are weaker acids than water.

blocks.prompt:
12 What is a positive inductive effect? Which group in alcohols shows it?
(Positive inductive effect kya hai? Alcohols mein kaun sa group yeh dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electron dene wale groups covalent bond mein electrons dhakelte hain; isay positive inductive effect kehte hain. Alcohols mein alkyl group electron deta hai aur yeh effect dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Electron-donating species push electrons into a covalent bond and are said to have a positive inductive effect.

blocks.prompt:
13 Give reason: the alkyl group makes ethanol less acidic than water.
(Wajah batayein: alkyl group ethanol ko paani se kam acidic bana deta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Electron dene wala alkyl group ethoxide ion (CH₃CH₂O⁻) ke O par electron density barhata hai. Is se ion ghair-mustahkam hota hai aur foran H⁺ le kar dobara ethanol ban jata hai. Is liye ethanol paani se kam ionise hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The alkyl groups destabilize the alkoxide ion, which is formed by removing one proton (H⁺) from the alcohol molecule.

blocks.prompt:
14 What is the conjugate base of phenol? Why is it stable?
(Phenol ka conjugate base kya hai? Yeh mustahkam kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenoxide ion, C₆H₅O⁻. Is ke oxygen ka aik lone pair ring ke delocalised π system se overlap karta hai, negative charge ring par phail jata hai; yeh delocalisation (phailao) ion ko mustahkam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The delocalisation stabilises the phenoxide ion, the conjugate base of phenol.

blocks.prompt:
15 Why does the phenoxide ion re-form phenol less readily than the ethoxide ion re-forms ethanol?
(Phenoxide ion dobara phenol kam aasaani se kyun banata hai jab ke ethoxide ion foran ethanol bana leta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenoxide mein charge ring mein phail jata hai aur O par charge density kam rehti hai, is liye H⁺ zor se nahi khinchta. Ethoxide mein alkyl group O par electron density barhata hai, is liye H⁺ zor se wapas khinchta hai.

book_ref.quote: The H⁺ ions are, therefore, not strongly attracted to the phenoxide ion and are less likely to reform the phenol molecule.

blocks.prompt:
16 Compare the acidity of phenol and ethanol in a table.
(Phenol aur ethanol ki acidity ka table mein muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Phenol paani se ziyada aur ethanol paani se kam acidic hai:

book_ref.quote: The relative acidities are as follows: phenol > water > ethanol

rows: O ka lone pair ring mein phailta hai; O par charge kam
Alkyl group electrons deta hai; O par charge ziyada
Conjugate base mustahkam; H⁺ zor se wapas nahi khinchta
Conjugate base ghair-mustahkam; foran H⁺ wapas leta hai

blocks.prompt:
17 Name the five kinds of compounds from which alcohols can be prepared.
(Un paanch qisam ke compounds ke naam likhein jin se alcohols banaye ja sakte hain.)
blocks.explanation: Alkenes, halogenoalkanes, carbonyl compounds (aldehydes aur ketones), carboxylic acids aur esters.

book_ref.quote: Alcohols can be prepared from alkenes, halogenoalkanes, carbonyl compounds, carboxylic acids, and esters.

blocks.prompt:
18 How is ethanol made from ethene? Write the equation and name the type of reaction.
(Ethene se ethanol kaise banta hai? Equation likhein aur reaction ki qisam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethene ko garam steam se concentrated H₃PO₄ catalyst ke saath react karaya jata hai: CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O → CH₃CH₂OH. Yeh electrophilic addition reaction hai.

book_ref.quote: When hot steam is reacted with an alkene, using concentrated phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) as a catalyst, electrophilic addition takes place to form an alcohol.

blocks.prompt:
19 What type of alcohol is formed when an alkene is treated with cold, dilute KMnO₄? Name the role of KMnO₄ here.
(Alkene ko cold, dilute KMnO₄ se treat karne par kis qisam ka alcohol banta hai? Yahan KMnO₄ ka kirdaar kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diol (do -OH wala alcohol) banta hai, maslan ethene se 1,2-ethanediol. Cold, dilute KMnO₄ halka oxidising agent hai.

book_ref.quote: Alcohols are obtained by the oxidation of alkenes with cold, dilute KMnO₄, a mild oxidising agent.

blocks.prompt:
20 Write the equation for the preparation of ethanol from bromoethane and name the type of reaction.
(Bromoethane se ethanol banane ki equation likhein aur reaction ki qisam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Bromoethane ko aqueous NaOH ke saath garam kiya jata hai: CH₃CH₂Br + NaOH → CH₃CH₂OH + NaBr. -OH halogen ki jagah leta hai; yeh nucleophilic substitution hai.

book_ref.quote: The halogen atom in halogenoalkanes can be substituted by –OH group when heated with aqueous NaOH in a nucleophilic substitution reaction, giving an alcohol.

blocks.prompt:
21 What type of alcohol is obtained by reducing (i) an aldehyde (ii) a ketone? Give one example of each.
(Reduce karne par (i) aldehyde (ii) ketone se kis qisam ka alcohol milta hai? Har aik ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ se: (i) aldehyde se primary alcohol, maslan ethanal → ethanol; (ii) ketone se secondary alcohol, maslan propanone → propan-2-ol.

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes and ketones can be reduced by reducing agents such as NaBH₄ or LiAlH₄ to obtain alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
22 How is ethanoic acid converted into ethanol? Which class of alcohol is formed?
(Ethanoic acid ko ethanol mein kaise badla jata hai? Kis qisam ka alcohol banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid, CH₃COOH, ko LiAlH₄ se reduce kar ke ethanol, CH₃CH₂OH, banaya jata hai. Carboxylic acids se primary alcohols bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, carboxylic acids are reduced by LiAlH₄ to primary alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
23 What is formed when ethyl ethanoate is heated with dilute acid? Write the equation.
(Ethyl ethanoate ko dilute acid ke saath garam karne par kya banta hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Is ki hydrolysis (paani se todna) ho kar ethanoic acid aur ethanol bante hain: CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O → CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH.

book_ref.quote: When an ester is heated with dilute acid or alkali, hydrolysis takes place and a carboxylic acid and alcohol are formed.

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between the reduction products of aldehydes and ketones.
(Aldehydes aur ketones ke reduction se banne wali cheezon mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ se reduce hote hain magar alcohol ki qisam mukhtalif hai:

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes are reduced to primary alcohols. Ketones are reduced to secondary alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
25 Write the balanced equation for the complete combustion of ethanol. Why is ethanol used as a fuel?
(Ethanol ke mukammal combustion ki balanced equation likhein. Ethanol fuel kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O, ΔH°c = −1367 kJ mol⁻¹. Yeh bohat exothermic (heat dene wala) hai, is liye kuch mulkon mein ethanol petrol ka mutabadil hai.

book_ref.quote: Alcohols when ignited, undergo complete combustion to form carbon dioxide and water.

blocks.prompt:
26 ΔH°c of ethanol is −1367 kJ mol⁻¹. How much heat is released when 0.30 mol of ethanol burns completely?
(Ethanol ka ΔH°c −1367 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. 0.30 mol ethanol ke poora jalne par kitni heat nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nikalne wali heat = moles × 1367 kJ mol⁻¹ = 0.30 × 1367 = 410.1 kJ (≈ 410 kJ).

book_ref.quote: The above reaction is highly exothermic; this is why the alcohol is used as an alternate to petrol in some countries.

blocks.prompt:
27 How many moles of O₂ are needed, and how many moles of CO₂ are produced, when 0.25 mol of ethanol burns completely?
(0.25 mol ethanol ke mukammal jalne mein kitne mol O₂ lagti hai aur kitne mol CO₂ banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O se: O₂ = 0.25 × 3 = 0.75 mol; CO₂ = 0.25 × 2 = 0.50 mol.

book_ref.quote: Alcohols when ignited, undergo complete combustion to form carbon dioxide and water.

blocks.prompt:
28 What is meant by substitution of an alcohol? Write the reaction of ethanol with HCl.
(Alcohol ki substitution se kya muraad hai? Ethanol ka HCl se reaction likhein.)
blocks.explanation: -OH group ki jagah koi aur group (jaise halogen) aa jata hai aur halogenoalkane banta hai. CH₃CH₂OH + HCl → CH₃CH₂Cl + H₂O, ZnCl₂ ke saath.

book_ref.quote: In the substitution of alcohols, a hydroxy group (-OH) is replaced by another substituent (e.g. halogens) to form a new product (e.g., halogenoalkanes).

blocks.prompt:
29 Write the reaction of ethanol with sodium. Which bond breaks?
(Ethanol ka sodium se reaction likhein. Kaun sa bond toot-ta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2CH₃CH₂OH + 2Na → 2CH₃CH₂ONa + H₂(g). Hydroxyl group ka O-H bond toot-ta hai; sodium ethoxide (base) aur hydrogen gas bante hain.

book_ref.quote: When an alcohol reacts with a reactive metal such as sodium (Na), the oxygen-hydrogen bond in the hydroxly group breaks.

blocks.prompt:
30 How can sodium metal be used as a test for the hydroxy group?
(Sodium metal ko hydroxy group ke test ke liye kaise istemal kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Compound mein sodium dala jata hai. Agar -OH mojood ho to O-H bond toot kar hydrogen gas ke bulbule nikalte hain; zaa'id alcohol urane par safed crystalline sodium alkoxide bachta hai.

book_ref.quote: Bubbles of hydrogen gas are released if a hydroxy group is present.

blocks.prompt:
31 How does phenolphthalein show that sodium reacts more slowly with ethanol than with water?
(Phenolphthalein kaise dikhata hai ke sodium ethanol se paani ki nisbat aahista react karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein sodium base banata hai. Ethanol aur phenolphthalein mein pink rang aahista banta hai; paani mein foran. Yani Na ethanol se aahista react karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It shows that reaction of Na with ethanol is slower than with water.

blocks.prompt:
32 Arrange methanol, ethanol and propan-1-ol in order of decreasing vigour of reaction with sodium. Give reason.
(Methanol, ethanol aur propan-1-ol ko sodium se reaction ki tezi ki ghatti tarteeb mein likhein. Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Methanol > ethanol > propan-1-ol. Alcohol ki hydrocarbon chain jitni lambi, sodium se reaction utna kam tez.

book_ref.quote: The longer the hydrocarbon chain in the alcohol, the less vigorous the reaction becomes.

blocks.prompt:
33 How many moles of hydrogen gas are released when 0.40 mol of ethanol reacts with excess sodium?
(0.40 mol ethanol zaa'id sodium se react kare to kitne mol hydrogen gas nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2CH₃CH₂OH + 2Na → 2CH₃CH₂ONa + H₂: 2 mol ethanol se 1 mol H₂, to H₂ = 0.40 ÷ 2 = 0.20 mol.

book_ref.quote: If the excess ethanol is evaporated off after the reaction, a white crystalline solid of sodium alkoxide is left.

blocks.prompt:
34 Write the oxidation of ethanol and of propan-2-ol, naming the products.
(Ethanol aur propan-2-ol ke oxidation likhein aur products ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethanol (primary): CH₃CH₂OH + [O] → CH₃CHO + H₂O, ethanal (aldehyde). Propan-2-ol (secondary), garam karne par: CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ + [O] → CH₃COCH₃ + H₂O, propanone (ketone).

book_ref.quote: Primary alcohols can be oxidised to form aldehydes and the secondary alcohols can be oxidised to form only ketones using oxidizing agents.

blocks.prompt:
35 Differentiate between primary and tertiary alcohols in their behaviour towards acidified K₂Cr₂O₇.
(Acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ke saath primary aur tertiary alcohols ke ravaiye mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sirf primary alcohol oxidise hota hai:

book_ref.quote: Tertiary alcohols do not undergo oxidation.

rows: Oxidise ho kar aldehyde banta hai
Orange Cr₂O₇²⁻ green Cr³⁺ mein reduce hota hai
Rang nahi badalta; orange rehta hai

blocks.prompt:
36 How is acidified potassium dichromate(VI) used to test for primary or secondary alcohols?
(Acidified potassium dichromate(VI) se primary ya secondary alcohol ka test kaise hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alcohol ko acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ke saath garam karein. Primary aur secondary alcohols oxidise hote hain aur orange Cr₂O₇²⁻ green Cr³⁺ ban jata hai. Tertiary alcohol se rang nahi badalta.

book_ref.quote: which is used to check the presence of primary or secondary alcohol

blocks.prompt:
37 Why must potassium dichromate(VI) be acidified to oxidise an alcohol?
(Alcohol ko oxidise karne ke liye potassium dichromate(VI) ko acidified kyun karna zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxidising agent ban-ne ke liye dichromate khud reduce hota hai (Cr₂O₇²⁻ → Cr³⁺). Is reduction ko H⁺ ions chahiye jo acidic medium deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This reduction requires hydrogen (H⁺) ions which are provided by the acidic medium.

blocks.prompt:
38 What is a breathalyser and on what principle does it work?
(Breathalyser kya hai aur kis usool par kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Traffic officers ka aala jo check karta hai ke driver nashe mein hai ya nahi. Saans ka ethanol oxidise hota hai; nikalne wale electrons current banate hain jo pi gayi alcohol ki miqdaar ke mutanasib (proportional) hai.

book_ref.quote: A breathalyser is a device that is used by the traffic officers to check if a driver is drunk or not.

blocks.prompt:
39 Define dehydration of alcohols. Write the equation for ethanol and name two dehydrating agents.
(Alcohols ki dehydration ki tareef karein. Ethanol ki equation likhein aur do dehydrating agents ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dehydration elimination reaction hai jis mein alcohol se paani ka molecule nikal kar alkene banta hai: CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O. Dehydrating agents: aluminium oxide, conc. sulphuric acid, conc. phosphoric acid.

book_ref.quote: Dehydration is the type of the elimination reaction in which a water molecule is removed.

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between dehydration of ethanol and its oxidation.
(Ethanol ki dehydration aur oxidation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein ethanol se atoms nikalte hain magar products mukhtalif hain:

book_ref.quote: Alcohols can also undergo dehydration to form alkenes.

rows: Reagent: Al₂O₃, conc. H₂SO₄ ya conc. H₃PO₄
Reagent: acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ ya acidified KMnO₄

blocks.prompt:
41 What are phenols? Give the formula and two other names or uses of the simplest phenol.
(Phenols kya hain? Sab se saada phenol ka formula aur is ke doosre naam ya istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Phenols woh compounds hain jin mein hydroxyl group arene (aromatic ring) se juda ho. Sab se saada C₆H₅OH hai, safed crystalline solid; isay carbolic acid kehte hain aur yeh carbolic soap mein istemal hua.

book_ref.quote: Compounds in which a hydroxyl group is bonded to an arene called phenols.

blocks.prompt:
42 Why is nitrous acid prepared in situ, and how?
(Nitrous acid in situ (wahin par) kyun aur kaise banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: HNO₂ itna ghair-mustahkam hai ke rakha nahi ja sakta. Isay test-tube mein sodium nitrite aur dilute HCl se, barf ke saath 10°C se kam par banaya jata hai: NaNO₂ + HCl → HNO₂ + NaCl.

book_ref.quote: The HNO₂ is so unstable that it needs to be prepared in a test-tube by reacting sodium nitrite (NaNO₂) and dilute hydrochloric acid (HCl)

blocks.prompt:
43 Write the equation for the last step in the preparation of phenol from phenylamine.
(Phenylamine se phenol banane ke aakhri step ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Diazonium salt ke solution ko paani ke saath garam kiya jata hai aur yeh toot jata hai (hydrolysis): C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + H₂O → C₆H₅OH + N₂ + HCl.

book_ref.quote: Phenol is made by warming the diazonium salt solution with water

blocks.prompt:
44 Give reason: the diazonium salt is warmed with water, not with NaOH, to obtain phenol.
(Wajah batayein: phenol hasil karne ke liye diazonium salt ko NaOH ke bajaye paani ke saath garam kiya jata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Alkali mein banne wala phenol phenoxide ban jata hai jo bache hue diazonium ions se jud kar phenol ke bajaye azo dye bana deta hai. Paani ke saath salt seedha phenol, N₂ aur HCl deta hai.

book_ref.quote: In alkali the phenol would form phenoxide and couple with the remaining diazonium ions to give an azo dye.

blocks.prompt:
45 Why can phenols take part in two kinds of reactions? Name one reaction of each kind.
(Phenols do qisam ke reactions mein kyun hissa le sakte hain? Har qisam ka aik reaction batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Polar OH group aur electron se bharpoor benzene ring dono react kar sakte hain. OH group: NaOH se sodium phenoxide aur paani. Ring: bromine water se bromination ho kar 2,4,6-tribromophenol.

book_ref.quote: Phenols can undergo many types of reactions as both the electron-rich benzene ring and the polar OH group can participate in chemical reactions.

blocks.prompt:
46 Give reason: phenol is only slightly soluble in water but dissolves in aqueous NaOH.
(Wajah batayein: phenol paani mein kam hal hota hai magar aqueous NaOH mein hal ho jata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Bara non-polar benzene ring phenol ko paani mein kam hal hone deta hai. Halka acidic hone ki wajah se yeh NaOH se acid-base reaction kar ke hal hone wala salt sodium phenoxide aur paani banata hai: C₆H₅OH + NaOH → C₆H₅ONa + H₂O.

book_ref.quote: Phenols are only slightly soluble in water due to the large non-polar benzene ring.

blocks.prompt:
47 Write the balanced equation for the reaction of molten phenol with sodium. What type of reaction is it?
(Pighle hue phenol ka sodium se reaction ki balanced equation likhein. Yeh kis qisam ka reaction hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2C₆H₅OH + 2Na → 2C₆H₅ONa + H₂. Yeh acid-base reaction hai; hal hone wala salt sodium phenoxide banta hai aur hydrogen gas nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Molten phenols react vigorously with reactive metals such as sodium (Na).

blocks.prompt:
48 How many moles of H₂ are given off when 0.50 mol of phenol reacts completely with sodium?
(0.50 mol phenol sodium se poora react kare to kitne mol H₂ nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2C₆H₅OH + 2Na → 2C₆H₅ONa + H₂: 2 mol phenol se 1 mol H₂, to H₂ = 0.50 ÷ 2 = 0.25 mol.

book_ref.quote: it is drawn as 2 phenol + 2Na -> 2 sodium phenoxide + H2

blocks.prompt:
49 Write the reaction of phenol with ethanoyl chloride and name the type of product.
(Phenol ka ethanoyl chloride se reaction likhein aur product ki qisam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Base ki mojoodgi mein garam karne par: CH₃COCl + C₆H₅OH → CH₃COOC₆H₅ + HCl. Product phenyl ethanoate ester hai.

book_ref.quote: The product, phenyl ethanoate (CH₃COOC₆H₅), is an ester, not an ether

blocks.prompt:
50 Why is a base added when phenol reacts with an acyl chloride?
(Phenol aur acyl chloride ke reaction mein base kyun milaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Base phenol se proton nikalta hai: C₆H₅OH + OH⁻ → C₆H₅O⁻ + H₂O. Phenoxide ion phenol se behtar nucleophile hai aur acyl chloride ke carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The phenoxide ion is a better nucleophile than the original phenol molecule and will be able to attack the carbonyl carbon.

blocks.prompt:
51 Give reason: the -OH group activates the benzene ring of phenol.
(Wajah batayein: -OH group phenol ki benzene ring ko activate karta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen ka aik lone pair ring ke π system se overlap kar ke phail jata hai aur ring ki electron density barh jati hai. Is liye ring par electrophile ka hamla aasaan hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to the increased electron density, the benzene ring is more likely to undergo electrophilic attack and becomes activated.
